environmentVariables.description: Set to true to accept self-signed certificates, scoped to this connection
environmentVariables.name: IMAP_INSECURE_TLS

environmentVariables.description: Drafts folder to save into; by default the one flagged \Drafts is used
environmentVariables.name: IMAP_DRAFTS_MAILBOX

environmentVariables.description: Default number of messages a listing returns (default: 100)
environmentVariables.name: IMAP_MAX_MESSAGES

environmentVariables.description: Ceiling for returning an attachment inline (default: 1048576)
environmentVariables.name: IMAP_MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Ceiling for writing an attachment to disk (default: 26214400)
environmentVariables.name: IMAP_MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Ceiling for reading a document's text with mode=text (default: 10485760, maximum: 67108864)
environmentVariables.name: IMAP_MAX_EXTRACT_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Seconds one IMAP command may take before the call is abandoned (default: 30, maximum: 600)
environmentVariables.name: IMAP_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated content-type allowlist for attachments
environmentVariables.name: IMAP_ATTACHMENT_TYPES

environmentVariables.description: authserv-id your provider stamps into Authentication-Results; without it every verdict is reported as forgeable
environmentVariables.name: IMAP_TRUSTED_AUTHSERV_ID
